title: fault-tolerant-eval-retry-queue-and-dead-letter-telemetry
author: Priya Nambiar
description:
Motivation: Some long-running eval jobs encounter transient infra errors or malformed samples that cause repeated noisy failures and obscure real regressions. This PR implements a fault-tolerant retry queue for eval workloads, a configurable dead-letter queue (DLQ) for persistent failures, and richer telemetry to attribute failure reasons per-prompt and per-probe. The intent is to reduce false-positive regression gates and provide an automated quarantine path for broken prompt-sets so that CI and on-call workflows can focus on real model regressions.

Design summary: single-process-safe persistent retry queue (lightweight on-disk index + in-memory lease map) that wraps existing eval workers; configurable retry/backoff policy per-cohort; DLQ sink that records full failure context (tokenization, exception type, response snippet, model-version, seed) and exposes a CI hook that converts DLQ hotspots into a temporary quarantine snapshot. Telemetry: new metrics (eval_retry_attempts_total, eval_dlq_events_total, eval_dlq_reason_{type}) and per-prompt tagging (prompt_id, cohort, linear_ticket when linked). The CI extension: a post-eval step that checks DLQ density against thresholds and will annotate the PR with a summary and optionally create a Linear ticket when a stability threshold is exceeded (controlled by feature flag).

What changed (high level): added retry-queue implementation under eval_harness/retry_queue.py; DLQ writer and schema under eval_harness/dlq.py; CI adapter ext/eval_dlq_ci_adapter.py which runs in the GH Actions eval workflow; metrics instrumentation in eval_harness/metrics.py; unit + integration tests under tests/retry and tests/dlq; docs updates in docs/ci-hooks.md and docs/troubleshooting.md; small changes to worker loop in eval_harness/worker.py to plug the retry wrapper.

Testing and safety: included deterministic unit coverage for backoff calc, persistence rehydration, and DLQ formatting. Integration tests spin up a local sqlite-backed queue and simulate transient gRPC errors and malformed responses. Added a small smoke test to the CI matrix that toggles feature-flag EVAL_DLQ_ENABLED. The feature is behind a runtime flag and defaults to OFF for existing release channels. Rollout plan: staged rollout on canary infra for 48h, monitor eval_retries vs baseline and DLQ rates; if noisy, tune default backoff and failure classification before enabling on main.

Related work: complements ENG-1428 (quarantine workflow) and ENG-1582 (structured eval telemetry). Linear attachments: sample DLQ output schema and example quarantine manifest are included in the PR.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps DLQ records compact (no raw user PII) and includes a redact hook for customer-owned prompt text; team SRE/security reviewed storage encryption and retention (90 days by default).

release_notes: Add fault-tolerant eval retry queue, dead-letter queue for persistent failures, DLQ CI adapter to quarantine noisy prompt-sets and auto-create Linear tickets when thresholds exceed policy. New metrics: eval_retry_attempts_total, eval_dlq_events_total. Feature gated behind EVAL_DLQ_ENABLED.
additional_context: This PR is designed to be conservative: feature disabled by default, default retention and redaction applied, and explicit opt-in to automatic Linear creation. Will follow up with a small runbook for on-call to triage DLQ hotspots.
